C0_incremental_shipped.description: one new dense product per age, reusing the previous age's leg

C1_explicit_suffix_precompute.description: form T2..T4 explicitly (3 products, chain-order-invariant since all factors are n x n) then apply T1..T4 to P_b (4 more)

C2_independent_per_age.description: recompute each age's leg from scratch, no reuse across ages

verdict: no candidate found cheaper than the shipped incremental order (C0); C1 and C2 are strictly more expensive, C3 (batching) is FLOP-neutral (measured directly, see sonnet10_unit_costs.json).
